content.title: In Nashville, a Four Seasons Penthouse Seeks a Record $33.5 Million
content.summary: In Nashville, Tenn., where luxury home prices have skyrocketed in recent years, a penthouse at the Four Seasons Hotel and Private Residences is aiming for a record with a $33.5 million asking price.  The penthouse is also available for rent at $200,000 a month for a minimum of six months, and is one of the city’s priciest rentals, Parsons said.  The newly completed Four Seasons is in downtown Nashville near the Ascend Amphitheater.

content.title: Why Analysts Think Compass Could Be Undervalued As The Anywhere Deal Reshapes Its Story
content.summary: Compass stock has just received a modest bump in its fair value estimate, rising from about $10.22 per share to approximately $10.67 as analysts recalibrate their models around the pending Anywhere Real Estate acquisition. With a slightly lower discount rate and revenue growth expectations holding near 10.15%, the Street is signaling greater confidence that scale, cost synergies and deleveraging can support a higher long term valuation. content.title: Dodgers First Baseman Freddie Freeman Sells L.A. Home for $6.45 Million
content.summary: THE DEAL: Los Angeles Dodgers’ first baseman Freddie Freeman and his wife, Chelsea Freeman, sold their L.A. house for $6.45 million—$1.375 million less than they paid in 2023.  “This home was purchased after their initial move to LA,” Ginger Glass of Compass, one of the listing agents, said in an email.  The main residence has a grand staircase with custom brass handrails.
